text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Streaming latency spike detected on /v1/chat/stream (prod-dedicated-eu). p95 jumped from ~420ms to ~1.8s, p99 from ~1.2s to ~4.9s over last 5m. Error rate +0.15%. A/B canary q-profile 'qv2-int8' rolled out 18m ago to 10% — correlates with surge.

infra-oncall: seeing lots of streaming stalls, clients report chunked responses that stop for multiple seconds then resume. tail tokens stack up.

sanjay: confirmed. KV cache miss spikes on pods running qv2-int8; logs show repeated dequant KV errors then retries.

carla: are affected requests mainly long-context (>1024) or embeddings?

mo: mostly long-context chat sessions. p95 for short requests unchanged. Looks like dequant path regresses when KV cache size grows.

support-liz: we have one enterprise customer (AcmePayments) seeing degraded UX, they've opened a ticket and flagged as P1.

infra-oncall: paging infra-oncall -> @sanjay / @carla for triage. Mo, can you try rolling the canary back?

mo: starting rollback of qv2-int8 canary from 10% -> 0% now. command:
```bash
# toggle canary weight
redwoodctl rollout set --pool prod-dedicated-eu --model roberta-qv2-int8 --weight 0
redwoodctl rollout set --pool prod-dedicated-eu --model roberta-fp16 --weight 100
```

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by mo at 3123456798. Canary weight change in progress (expected 30s to converge).

carla: can we also enable fallback routing for long-context routes to fp16? policy currently prefers lower-cost variants.

sanjay: doing policy override: switching streaming-route -> prefer fp16 for seq_len > 1024. command:
```json
{"route": "/v1/chat/stream", "preference": [{"model_tag":"fp16","min_seq":1024}], "ttl":60}
```
(putting this as a quick policy patch)

infra-oncall: monitoring p95/p99, tail latencies, and KV error logs.

ops-bot: Canary rollback observed by runtime at 3123456815, qv2-int8 weight=0. System note: new routing policy active.

mo: preliminary metrics: p95 dropped from 1.8s -> 480ms within 90s, p99 trending down from 4.9s -> 1.3s. Error rate back near baseline.

support-liz: updated AcmePayments with mitigation and ETA for root cause analysis. They acknowledged and asked for postmortem.

sanjay: next steps: gather calibs from qv2-int8 canary pods, diff against control, and run head-to-head with long-context synthetic harness. Possible hypothesis: quant scale factors drifted during KV cache warm-up leading to dequant stalls on slower dequant kernel path.

carla: assigning: @sanjay run repro and collect calib dumps; @mo validate routing fallback logs; @infra-oncall assemble timeline for incident page.

mo: noted. I'll keep the rollback live until we confirm profile fix, then we can attempt a controlled re-roll with stricter long-context gating.

ops-bot: Incident severity: HIGH -> paging closed after mitigation. Created ticket INC-3123 for RCA.

infra-oncall: adding quick mitigation checklist to ticket:
- rollback qv2-int8 canary -> done
- enforce fp16 preference for seq>1024 -> done
- throttle canary rollout automation for precision changes -> set to manual for next 24h
- run 10k long-context sims against qv2-int8 locally

sanjay: I'll upload calib diffs and heap traces to INC-3123 by EOD. If hypothesis holds we'll add an additional calibration pass that includes KV warm-up sequences.

carla: note for postmortem: include customer impact windows, exact p95/p99 graphs, and the canary gating gap (we used only request-rate gating, missed long-context distribution).

support-liz: I'll coordinate customer comms + follow-up.

infra-oncall: closing slack loop here. If anyone sees reappearance ping #incidents immediately. :white_check_mark:
